text:
Thank you for all your support, help, and patience during the many hours we spent at your clinic. The doctor drove back three (!!!) times to check on our daughter because she wasn’t feeling well.
We felt completely taken care of and in the right place during such a difficult situation. The young lady working there was incredibly kind, helpful, and supportive throughout all those hours, always staying positive.
Everything was documented very accurately and in an exemplary way, so that everything remains clear and traceable.
If you ever need help from a doctor or nurse, go there — you won’t regret it. They truly follow their profession with all their heart. We really need more people like them in our selfish world.
All the best to you!

10/5 stars :)

I went to this clinic for my 2-year-old daughter.

We were seen quickly. The staff was kind and caring.

I received a bill for 800 euros, along with a list of tests to be carried out and medications to be prescribed before the lab results were returned.

In conclusion, after sending the completed tests and treatments back to France, it turns out that some of them were unnecessary.

I had to return that evening to request a medication that hadn't been initially prescribed. Naturally, I refused to pay for it.

Having accepted the bill, which included the tests and medications, before the start of treatment, I don't understand why I should have to pay extra for something that, in my opinion, was included in the initial package.
The care and advice given were excellent. The doctor and staff were very friendly and lovely. The place and environment were clean.
The clinic looks clean, has a comfortable waiting area, and all the staff are lovely.
